title: The ending epilogue names places/threads no quest, NPC, or status line ever surfaced in ~530 turns of thorough play: 'the Choir of Ash... above Glasswick' and 'the Farlight' off Gullhaven's point. A first-time player has no way to know these exist or how they'd be reached.
